d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Tanzania has achieved a landmark energy milestone with its first new natural gas discovery in over a decade. Located in the southern Mnazi Bay area, the newly tapped well—drilled jointly by state-owned Tanzania Petroleum Development Corporation (TPDC) and French energy firm Maurel & Prom—holds an estimated 223 billion cubic feet of gas reserves. With natural gas currently generating nearly 80 percent of Tanzania's national electricity, the discovery promises immediate relief by boosting local grid reliability and reducing operational costs for…
